g.text: 98 × 45 tile factory · 66 machines · 13 substations · No belts
Iron ore + copper ore + coal + water + crude oil → roboports, both robot types and big electric poles
STARTUP: add 200 logistic robots to the two nearby roboports. All five raw inputs and electricity must be supplied.
Heavy oil → lubricant + surplus cracking. Light oil → petroleum. Every intermediate is made inside the mall.
Exact blueprint positions. The complete original 5 × 5 extension is included. Place in an empty matching bay.
Normal-quality ingredients and equipment. Factorio 2.0 + Space Age. Construction materials and starter robots are separate from operating inputs.
